newsitem.title: USA: Prudential in policyholder settlement, attorney.
newsitem.headline: Prudential in policyholder settlement, attorney.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co. of America agreed to pay at least $410 million to settle lawsuits by policyholders claiming they were improperly sold life insurance policies, an attorney for the plaintiffs said.

Under the settlement, about 10.7 million policyholders are eligible to apply for restitution, Melvyn Weiss, one of the lead attorneys negotiating the settlement, said in a telephone conference call with reporters.

The settlement improves the terms of an agreement Prudential reached with a multi-state task force this summer, providing policyholders with the potential for greater relief and making it easier for them to qualify for it, Weiss said.
Weiss expects the policyholders to enter into a formal agreement with Prudential on Oct. 25 and a notice to class members to be sent out in November.
A court hearing to determine whether or not the settlement is fair is likely to be held sometime in February or March.
